message.content: We have 12,400 active customers at the start of the quarter and 508 of them cancelled during it. What is our quarterly churn rate?

content.text: Quarterly churn is 508 / 12,400 = 4.1%. Method: customers active on day 1 form the base, a cancellation counts if it happened within the 90-day quarter, trial accounts (1,200) are not in the 12,400, and reactivations are not netted out. By plan it splits as 3.2% on annual plans and 5.0% on monthly plans.

message.content: How many customers are on each plan, and how many cancellations came from each?

content.text: Monthly plans: 6,200 customers and 310 cancellations. Annual plans: 6,200 customers and 198 cancellations. Together that is 508.
